_doc: at query time by TargetRegistry.queryNearby (iteration 2.8) and turned
into a real walkable point by anchor resolution (iteration 2.9).
'radial': sample `slots`-independent points on a circle of `radius`
around the target, discard non-walkable, pick nearest to the agent.
'fixed': a single point at `offset` in the target's own local frame,
rotated by rot*90 degrees, facing `facing` quarter-turns.
fishing's fallbackRadius is NOT authored here as a literal — it is
POND.radius + 4, computed in config/index.ts's anchorRuleFor() from the
real pond definition (game/data/world.ts), so it can never drift out of
sync with the pond's actual size the way a second hardcoded number could.
